label: All 12 measured advisor calls exit 0 on a live graph (trustState generation 1033, confidence 0.8, uncertainty 0.35).
Ten of twelve plain-word setup/health prompts return zero recommendations, so the hook renders no-skill-matched for them.
Three of the four topic-named example prompts (help me set up skilled, is my repo set up right, why is this rule not enforced) return empty; only check my git hooks routes.
check my git hooks routes to sk-git at confidence 0.8316, score 0.579682, dominant explicit_author, driven by the git token boost rather than hooks vocabulary.
help me get started with this repo routes to sk-doc at confidence 0.82 with score 0.229089 via the lexical lane and a compiledRoute defer action.
Recommendations surface on confidence (0.8) rather than raw score, so calibration behaviour matters as much as phrase coverage.
Empty results carry freshness live and a current generation, proving routing gaps rather than staleness or daemon failure.
No recommendation in the sample carries kind command; both non-empty results are skills (sk-git, sk-doc), so doctor commands are not candidates today.
Every payload carries a _shadow advisor-shadow-learned-weights-v1 block with liveWeightsFrozen true and parallel shadow scores, telemetry-only.
Twelve raw envelopes plus an index (exit code, duration, bytes, prompt) are persisted in the lineage for regression baselining.
